# Trevor Noon

> Trevor Noon leads product teams and builds with AI. He is Head of Product at Tribe AI and lives in Durham, NC.

He has built and launched products with Amazon, Meta, OpenAI, and Anthropic, and studied statistics and astrophysics at Harvard. This file is a plain-text summary of https://trevornoon.com for AI assistants and LLM tools.

## Experience

- Head of Product, Tribe AI: leads product for one of Tribe's largest enterprise AI programs, spanning four product pods with 30+ engineers, designers, and data scientists. Tribe AI designs and builds production AI solutions for Fortune 1000 companies.
- MCP Consultant, Anthropic: built infrastructure for Anthropic's MCP offering and co-authored an MCP security guide.
- Llama API Consultant, Meta: led a developer experience and documentation effort for Meta's Llama API, and benchmarked it against leading LLM providers to close usability and onboarding gaps.
- Product Lead, A.Team: contract product lead for Grindr, covering monetization and CX for 14M+ users. AI-powered features generated $7M+ in annual subscription revenue, and AI content moderation saved $1.2M+ a year.
- Senior Product Manager, Enterprise Lead, Woebot Health: generated $5M+ in revenue deploying AI-powered chatbots to health systems and payers, and more than doubled renewals by building Spotlight, an external analytics product.
- Technical Product Manager, AWS Infrastructure, Amazon: $52.5M in savings from ML-powered forecasting for data center build schedules, plus $10M in networking cost savings from automated workflows.
- First Product Manager, Nirvana: first product hire at a seed-stage healthcare/fintech startup. Scaled a $1B+ telehealth partnership and shipped insurance eligibility products driving $4M in ARR.
- Investor, Activant: built a software tool that identified 300+ investment targets, including two of the firm's largest investments, where he later served as Board Observer.
- Head of Data Science, Monster Roster: built a statistical model for MLB, NFL, and NBA daily fantasy sports with a 55% win rate, driving 5,000+ subscriptions and $250K in revenue.
- Education: Bachelor's in Statistics and Astrophysics, Harvard College.

## Projects and writing

Each project has its own page on trevornoon.com.

- [Forage](https://trevornoon.com/projects/forage/): his personal media library. It tracks what he's reading, watching and listening to, and brings back new picks every morning.
- [Form](https://trevornoon.com/projects/form/): his CrossFit training journal, built around four goals: the 1,000 lb club, 12 classes a month, a better VO2 max, and lower body fat.
- [OpenAI Model Selection Guide](https://trevornoon.com/projects/openai-model-selection-guide/): co-author. Reader view of the guide; the original is on the [OpenAI Cookbook](https://cookbook.openai.com/examples/partners/model_selection_guide/model_selection_guide).
- [SitterBot](https://trevornoon.com/projects/sitterbot/): an AI assistant for babysitters, built as a prototype with a waitlist.
- [Securing MCPs for the Autonomous Age](https://trevornoon.com/projects/securing-mcps/): co-written with Andres March for Tribe AI. Reader view of the article; the original is [archived here](https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://www.tribe.ai/applied-ai/securing-mcps-for-the-autonomous-age-your-ai-assistant-just-leaked-your-customer-database).
- [E Source Resume Screener](https://trevornoon.com/projects/esource-screener/): an AI resume screener built for E Source's hiring team.

## Favorites
